tasks.title: Acquire and harmonise multi-sensor EO and meteorological data
Implement Route A direct probabilistic fusion and Route B homogeneous-patch proxy
Calibrate diagnostic branch and produce field state posterior estimates
Implement uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration and parameter posterior
Develop counterfactual irrigation simulation and WUE-based decision engine
Build and integrate research demonstrator web MVP
Design and run field validation protocol on Hungarian tomato farms
Assess uncertainty calibration quality against RQ5 target
Run co-located patch-covariation campaign for Route B validation
Prepare, submit and periodically review Career Development Plan
Deliver structured transferable-skills training and supervision sessions
Develop and implement open-science dissemination and communication strategy
Manage project coordination, reporting and ethics oversight

milestones.title: Multi-sensor data pipeline operational; Data Management Plan delivered
milestones.verifiable_criterion: Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, soil-sensor and weather data are ingested, quality-controlled and harmonised over the field boundaries on the geospatial/time-series platform; the Data Management Plan is delivered as an open-science deliverable by month 6.

milestones.title: Diagnostic method v1 producing calibrated field-state posteriors
milestones.verifiable_criterion: Route A and/or Route B produce posterior estimates of the target latent field state (e.g. root-zone soil moisture, crop water stress) with explicit uncertainty over at least one growing season's data; route scope (RQ2) and field-state definition (RQ3) recorded as decided.

milestones.title: Uncertainty-aware decision engine integrated
milestones.verifiable_criterion: AquaCrop is calibrated retaining an honest parameter posterior; counterfactual irrigation simulations run over weather ensembles; the profit-based recommendation logic selects decisions by expected economic return under uncertainty, end to end from a diagnosed state.

milestones.title: Standalone research demonstrator exercises the end-to-end pipeline
milestones.verifiable_criterion: The web MVP runs the full observation-to-decision pipeline and presents irrigation recommendations with their uncertainty for at least one field case; TRL target (RQ10) recorded.

milestones.title: Field validation and uncertainty calibration complete
milestones.verifiable_criterion: Ground truth collected (RQ4); uncertainty-calibration metrics evaluated - e.g. prediction-interval coverage assessed against nominal (RQ5); Route B patch-covariation tested (RQ9); pilot-success criteria (RQ7) applied to the demonstrator.

milestones.title: Results disseminated and fellowship outcomes consolidated
milestones.verifiable_criterion: At least one open-access publication submitted covering the probabilistic fusion-to-decision framework; open data/models released under FAIR principles; dissemination/exploitation and communication actions executed per the plan.
